info.title: Tellurion — OGC API Tiles
info.description: OGC API — Common (Core, landing page, conformance, OpenAPI) plus Tiles Part 1 (WebMercatorQuad, plus WorldCRS84Quad on grid-capable drivers; MVT + PNG + styled PNG) for one catalog. Mounted at /{tenant}/tiles/catalogs/{catalog}.

200.description: Links to the API description, conformance declaration, and data.
The OpenAPI 3.0 document describing this API.

get.summary: List the tilesets available for a collection

200.description: Tileset list — one entry per tile matrix set the collection's resolved driver serves (WebMercatorQuad always; WorldCRS84Quad on grid-capable drivers, #190).

get.summary: Tileset metadata for a collection, in one tile matrix set

200.description: Tileset metadata, including the configured zoom range.

get.summary: Fetch a single vector or raster tile

parameters.name: tileCol
parameters.description: Tile column; an explicit `.mvt` or `.png` suffix overrides Accept-header negotiation.

204.description: A valid tile at this coordinate with no features to draw.

404.description: Unknown collection, or the zoom is outside the collection's configured range.

get.summary: List the supported tile matrix sets
One tile matrix set definition (WebMercatorQuad or WorldCRS84Quad, zoom 0-24)

404.description: An id this server's tile matrix set registry does not know.

get.summary: Render one styled map image of a collection (OGC API Maps)
get.description: Composites the collection's WebMercatorQuad tile pyramid into a single PNG window. Every parameter is optional, as the Maps Part 1 Core class requires: an omitted `bbox` renders the collection's own derived spatial extent (the same extent its collection metadata publishes), and omitted `width`/`height` render that window at the tile grid's own native scale. The zoom is picked from the resulting resolution; both the output image and the source tiles it needs are bounded by this server's pixel budget, refused by name rather than truncated.

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: Four comma-separated numbers in `bbox-crs` units: minX,minY,maxX,maxY. Each minimum must be strictly less than its maximum. Omitted renders this collection's own derived spatial extent; a collection with no known extent is refused by name (`CapabilityUnsupported`), never given a world bbox.

parameters.name: bbox-crs
parameters.description: The CRS `bbox` is expressed in. Omitted means this lane's native WebMercatorQuad CRS; any other URI is refused by name. Ignored when no `bbox` is supplied.

parameters.name: crs
parameters.description: The CRS the rendered window is projected into. Same closed set and same default as `bbox-crs`.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Output image width in pixels. Omitted with `height` supplied derives it from the window's aspect ratio; omitted with neither supplied renders the window at the tile grid's native scale (between 256 and 512 pixels on the longest side). A supplied value must still be a positive integer.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Output image height in pixels. Omitted with `width` supplied derives it from the window's aspect ratio; omitted with neither supplied renders the window at the tile grid's native scale (between 256 and 512 pixels on the longest side). A supplied value must still be a positive integer.

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: A registered style id to paint with; omitted renders the collection's own configured style.

Content-Crs.description: The CRS the image was rendered in, as `<URI>` — this lane's native WebMercatorQuad CRS unless `crs` asked otherwise.

Content-Bbox.description: The window this image actually covers, four comma-separated numbers in the `Content-Crs` CRS. The only way a client that supplied no `bbox` can georeference the result.

400.description: An invalid parameter, a collection with no extent to derive a window from, or a window over this server's pixel budget (output side or source-tile side).

404.description: Unknown collection, a collection with no tiles lane, or an unknown style id.

get.summary: Fetch a raster tile rendered with a named style

parameters.name: tileCol
parameters.description: Tile column; an explicit `.png` suffix overrides Accept-header negotiation. MVT is not an offerable format on this route — styling only affects rasterization.

200.description: The styled raster tile (MVT-first: fetched/cached like the unstyled PNG lane, then painted with the named style's resolved layer paints).

204.description: A valid tile at this coordinate with no features to draw.

400.description: Invalid coordinate, or the request negotiated to MVT (styled tiles are raster-only).

404.description: Unknown collection, or unknown style id.

tileMatrixSetId.name: tileMatrixSetId
tileMatrixSetId.description: The tile matrix set to serve from. WebMercatorQuad is always available; WorldCRS84Quad (#190) is served by grid-capable drivers, and a collection's own tileset list names which of the two it offers. An id outside this closed registry is a 404; a known id the collection's resolved lane cannot serve is refused by name.

f.name: f
f.description: Explicit output format, overriding Accept-header negotiation. An explicit path suffix (`.mvt`/`.png`) wins over this.

notFound.description: Unknown collection or feature, or the driver doesn't support this capability.
